problem:
Find the values of $k$ such that the vector $b$ lies in $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}},$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 10\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 3 \\ -12\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -9 \\ k\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
We know that $b\in \text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ if there exist ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 10\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 3 \\ -12\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -9 \\ k\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2}=-3 \\ -2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-9 \\ 10{x}_{1}-12{x}_{2}=k\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}6 & -8 & -3 \\ -2 & 3 & -9 \\ 10 & -12 & k\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -9 \\ 6 & -8 & -3 \\ 10 & -12 & k\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -9 \\ 0 & 1 & -30 \\ 10 & -12 & k\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -9 \\ 0 & 1 & -30 \\ 0 & 3 & k-45\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-3{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & -9 \\ 0 & 1 & -30 \\ 0 & 0 & k+45\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The third row of the augmented matrix now corresponds to the equation $0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}=k+45.$ Therefore, the system has a solution only if

$$
0=k+45\,⟹\,k=-45.
$$
